reviewRounds.finding: AIP-8 generic analyst shell, ecommerce L1 decision authority and canonical AIP Task authority were named together without a unique ownership boundary.
reviewRounds.remediation: Separated the generic query/plan shell, five ecommerce L1 authorities and canonical Task truth; froze exact-reference and disclosure contracts.

reviewRounds.finding: TaskGraph and EffectReview lacked atomic materialization, mapping/count conservation, maturity, late-data, inconclusive, correction and memory-promotion semantics; two status references still listed only three targets or AOS-000038.
reviewRounds.remediation: Added all-or-nothing idempotent materialization, stable mapping ledger and count equation, effect successor rules and MemoryCandidate governance; reconciled the five-target inventory to AOS-000040.
